ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: DoseTrace needs camera access so you can snap a photo of a lab report, vaccine card, or vial label.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DoseTrace needs photo library access to upload photos of lab reports, vaccine cards, and vial labels.
ios.NSDocumentPickerUsageDescription: DoseTrace needs access to your files to upload bloodwork and vaccine card PDFs.
